notes:
Summary: internal-engineering org building a unified code + doc search RAG platform. Primary ask: high-quality embeddings + candidate reranking at scale, low latency (p95 target 150ms end-to-end for developer queries), and tight security (SSO/SAML + EU data residency for product teams in Dublin).

Scale & ingestion:
- Plan to index ~120M artifacts (source code files, CI logs, internal docs) initially; growth to 300M+ over 12 months.
- Re-index cadence: nightly full sync for docs, near-real-time for code (webhook-driven commits). Frequent incremental updates are a hard requirement.

Embedding & retrieval profile:
- Prefer open/quantizable embedding models; will evaluate Redwood model catalog but need ability to pin models for reproducibility.
- Want hybrid retrieval (sparse + dense) + reranking: ANN for top-200 then cross-encoder GPU rerank top-20.
- Metrics asked: recall@10/50, MRR, cost/query (target <= $0.002/query all-in for retrieval+rerank), latency p50/p95.

Operational needs:
- Dedicated capacity or Private deployment for tenant isolation and predictable throughput.
- Autoscaling policy: sustained daytime burst for engineers (9am-6pm) and batch overnight indexing.
- KV caching and prefix caching important to reduce cost for repeated developer queries.

Security & compliance:
- Mandatory SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, KMS integration for keys.
- Data residency: EU for selected teams; legal requires contract clause.
- Retention controls: ability to expunge items on request (GDPR subject requests).

POC scope proposed by SE:
- Ingest 10M representative artifacts, run baseline with current vector DB (internal) vs Redwood Dedicated+rerank.
- Evaluate recall@10 and p95 latency; run A/B on developer satisfaction.
- Deliver cost model showing per-query and monthly ingest costs.

"What they said":
- "We need reranker quality that actually surfaces the right code snippets — recall matters more than raw throughput for developer DX."
- "Frequent re-indexing is not negotiable; we need near-real-time visibility when code changes."

Risks / open items:
- Network egress & VPC peering constraints with their on-prem Git backend.
- Cross-encoder rerank cost: they may require a staged fallback (cheap reranker then expensive rerank on-demand).
- Procurement wants a capped pilot cost before authorizing Dedicated infra.

Next steps (short):
- Priya to run ingestion estimate and share pilot system architecture (target 2026-03-16).
- Deliver security checklist + sample SOC2 evidence (SEC-2091).
- Schedule 90-min deep-dive demo focusing on reranking pipeline and cost controls (Jordan to own scheduling).
